decision: Block Jev first reviews; preserve existing finding and integration-repair re-reviews. Display re-review statistics only; retain raw gathering.

limitations: Original criteria continuity unverified; s19 demonstrably uses a later criterion.
Conditional mandatory-source budget selection, 23 archived + 7 extension families; not representative all missions.
17 families have prior repair-research membership; unused first-review revisions do not make families historically pristine.
Focused historical source with current node_modules; no full gate/static/manual certificate fabricated.
Whole-PR approval and literal mission criteria differ in s25.
Root post-call adjudication with historical reviewer comparison, no independent fresh adjudicator.
No matched review latency/cost baseline; workflow savings unknown.

lesson: Literal mission criteria can all pass while a broader PR blocker remains (TASK-2569). A limited evidence packet is not whole-PR approval. Green mocks also missed fallback and interface defects (TASK-2626, TASK-2579).
historicalComparator: Major error: Jev clears a correctly rejected historical PR. False returns cost implementer/review work; evaluate those in aggregate economics.
priorResearch: Repair-review positives are distinct from first-review approval and must not be disabled by this decision. Full cohort provenance and earlier experiments remain in the complete archive.
